reviews.review_title: The pearl earrings I bought for my wife…
reviews.review_text:
The pearl earrings I bought for my wife was beautiful.  Very elegant .
     Im not great with online ordering. I made a mistake and ordered 2 pairs of the same identical earrings.   When I realized this they were already shipped.  I contacted customer service, immediately they answered the phone.  Customer service was very professional understood my mistake and instantly sent me a return label.
   I immediately sent the extra pair of earrings back and within 5 days I received an email stating my money was placed back on my card.      
                 Very happy with the ordering , the quality, customer service and the quick response of the returned item.      Thank You.  Will definitely order again and recommend.
reviews.reply_text: Thank you for sharing your experience. We're delighted to hear you were pleased with the pearl earrings and that our customer service team was able to quickly help resolve the ordering issue. It's wonderful to know you were happy with the return process, refund, and overall experience. We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back.
